What your parent can see
Your parent set KidGuard up on this phone. This list is everything they can read. It always shows what is on.
Nothing right now. Your parent can only manage screen time, apps and location.
Your parent looked at your notifications
On
Never seen: your passwords, what you type, call audio, anything not listed above.
notifications
Your parent sees every notification you get (the app, the title and the text), as it arrives.
App, title, text and time of every notification (not ongoing ones such as music), as it arrives, and older ones when they ask.
notifications with your parent\'s words
Your parent gets the notifications that contain words they chose (the app, the title and the text).
Only notifications with one of their words: app, title, text and time. Sent when they arrive.
word alerts
Your parent gets an alert when a notification or a text message contains a word they chose.
An alert with the app and a short piece of the message around the word.
